== Description ==

[[Jonny Chu]] (left, glasses, short dark hair, black Team Albany hoodie), [[Joe Olson]] (mid-right, reddish hair, grey tee, back to the camera, holding a deck), and [[Mike French]] (right background, grey zip, glasses, short grey hair, name tag, looking at a phone) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
